simple.prompt: If I had known about the flight cancellation earlier, I ___ my hotel reservation.
simple.explanation: Third Conditional (pengandaian masa lalu yang mustahil diubah): If + had + V3, would have + V3.
hints: Pengandaian masa lalu yang sudah lewat.
Formula: would have + V3.

simple.prompt: We ___ the client contract if our sales proposal had been clearer.
simple.explanation: Hasil hipotetis masa lalu: would have won.
hints: Klausa kondisi 'had been clearer' (past perfect).
Gunakan 'would have won'.

simple.targetSentence: If you had warned me I would not have invested.
simple.explanation: If you had warned me + I would not have invested.
hints: Mulai dengan 'If you had warned me'.
Hasil negatif: 'I would not have invested'.

simple.prompt: If she had taken the express train, she ___ on time for the job interview.
simple.explanation: Third conditional mengandaikan peristiwa yang berlawanan dengan fakta masa lalu.
hints: Faktanya dia tidak naik kereta ekspres.
Gunakan 'would have arrived'.

simple.targetSentence: What would you have done if the flight had been cancelled?
simple.explanation: What would you have done + if the flight had been cancelled?
hints: Awali pertanyaan: 'What would you have done'.
Klausa kondisi: 'if the flight had been cancelled?'.

simple.prompt: If the paramedics ___ five minutes earlier, the patient might have survived.
simple.explanation: Dalam klausa 'if' pada Third Conditional, gunakan Past Perfect ('had arrived'), BUKAN 'would have arrived'.
hints: Pantang memakai 'would' di dalam klausa if.
Gunakan Past Perfect 'had arrived'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Third Conditional dengan modal 'could have'.
simple.targetSentence: They could have won the championship if they had practiced more.
simple.explanation: They could have won the championship + if they had practiced more.
hints: Potensi masa lalu: 'They could have won the championship'.
Kondisi: 'if they had practiced more'.

simple.prompt: If we had checked the tire pressure earlier, we wouldn't ___ missed the morning ferry.
simple.explanation: Third Conditional selalu mengikuti pola: 'If + had + V3, S + would/wouldn't + have + V3'.
hints: Setelah modal 'wouldn't' pada Tipe 3, gunakan 'have'.
Jangan memakai 'had' setelah 'wouldn't'.

simple.prompt: If Maya ___ accepted the Kyoto fellowship in 2021, she would have gained two years of lab experience.
simple.explanation: If-clause pada Third Conditional wajib menggunakan Past Perfect ('had + V3'), bukan 'would have'.
hints: Kejadiannya di masa lalu ('in 2021').
If-clause Tipe 3 memakai 'had + V3'.

simple.prompt: What would you have ___ if the client had rejected the revised schedule yesterday?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan hasil Third Conditional ('What would + S + have + V3...?') memerlukan V3: 'done'.
hints: Sudah ada 'would you have' sebelum rumpang.
Setelah 'have' pada Tipe 3 wajib memakai V3 ('done').

simple.prompt: If the backup batteries hadn't failed, the monitoring cameras would have ___ recording.
simple.explanation: Klausa hasil Third Conditional membutuhkan V3 setelah 'would have': V3 dari 'keep' adalah 'kept'.
hints: Pola: 'would have + V3'.
Keep - kept - kept.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang penyesalan masa lampau dengan Third Conditional.
dialogue: Manager
Why did the courier return the package to the warehouse?
Clerk
If someone ___ our phone number on the label, he could have called us.
simple.explanation: Pengandaian masa lalu yang tidak terjadi ('seandainya seseorang tadi menulis nomor telepon...') memakai Past Perfect ('had written') di dalam if-clause.
hints: Hasilnya memakai 'could have called' (Tipe 3).
If-clause Tipe 3 memakai 'had + V3'.

simple.prompt: We ___ have avoided the traffic bottleneck if we had taken the coastal highway.
simple.explanation: Klausa hasil Third Conditional memakai modal lampau ('would', 'could', atau 'might') + 'have + V3'.
hints: If-clause memakai 'had taken' (lampau).
Gunakan modal lampau 'could' di klausa hasil.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda meletakkan 'would have' di dalam if-clause Tipe 3 berikut.
simple.draft: If Riko would have double-checked the customs form, our crate wouldn't have been delayed.
options: If Riko had double-checked the customs form, our crate wouldn't have been delayed.
If Riko has double-checked the customs form, our crate wouldn't have been delayed.
If Riko double-check the customs form, our crate wouldn't have been delayed.
simple.explanation: Jangan pernah meletakkan 'would have' di dalam if-clause; gunakan Past Perfect 'had double-checked'.
hints: Klausa 'If' pada Tipe 3 hanya memakai Past Perfect ('had + V3').
Hapus 'would' dan gunakan 'had double-checked'.

simple.prompt: If she hadn't reminded me about the deadline, I ___ have forgotten to upload the PDF.
simple.explanation: Kemungkinan hasil masa lalu pada Third Conditional memakai modal bentuk lampau 'might' ('might have forgotten').
hints: If-clause memakai Past Perfect 'hadn't reminded'.
Pasangkan dengan modal lampau 'might' (bukan 'may').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Third Conditional positif yang tepat.
simple.targetSentence: If the technician had arrived earlier, we would have fixed the valve in time.
simple.explanation: If + had + V3 ('had arrived') diikuti koma dan klausa hasil 'would have + V3'.
hints: Awali dengan 'If the technician had arrived earlier,'.
Lengkapi klausa hasil 'we would have fixed...'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Third Conditional negatif di kedua klausanya.
simple.targetSentence: If they hadn't cut corners on testing, the app wouldn't have crashed.
simple.explanation: Kedua klausa berbentuk negatif: 'hadn't cut' dan 'wouldn't have crashed'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'If they hadn't cut corners on testing,'.
Akhiri dengan 'the app wouldn't have crashed'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog Mixed Conditional (Past Condition -> Present Result).
dialogue: Colleague
Why is the senior architect working on a Sunday?
Engineer
If he ___ the blue-prints yesterday, he wouldn't be here today.
intermediate.explanation: Mixed Conditional: Kondisi lampau yang tidak terjadi ('had finished yesterday') berpengaruh pada situasi saat ini ('wouldn't be here today').
hints: Kondisi masa lalu (yesterday) $\rightarrow$ had + V3.
Akibat masa kini (today) $\rightarrow$ would + V1.

intermediate.prompt: Mixed Conditional (Present State -> Past Result): 'If she ___ so terrified of flying, she would have accompanied us to New York last week.'
intermediate.explanation: Kondisi umum/sifat permanen masa kini ('If she weren't terrified') mempengaruhi tindakan masa lalu yang tidak diambil ('would have accompanied').
hints: Sifat ketakutan umum masa kini: 'weren't'.
Hasil lampau: 'would have accompanied'.

intermediate.prompt: Inversion in Third Conditional: '___ the alarm sounded earlier, the residents could have evacuated safely.'
intermediate.explanation: Inversi formal menghilangkan 'If' dengan memajukan auxiliary 'Had' ke depan subjek: 'Had the alarm sounded...'.
hints: Bentuk inversi formal tanpa kata 'if'.
Gunakan 'Had' di awal kalimat.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Mixed Conditional Past to Present.
intermediate.targetSentence: If I had accepted that job offer I would be living in Tokyo now.
intermediate.explanation: If I had accepted that job offer (past) + I would be living in Tokyo now (present).
hints: Mulai dengan 'If I had accepted that job offer'.
Hasil masa kini: 'I would be living in Tokyo now'.

intermediate.prompt: Replacing 'if' with 'But for': 'But for your prompt intervention, our business ___ bankrupt.'
intermediate.explanation: 'But for + noun' bermakna 'Jika bukan karena...'. Untuk konsekuensi masa lalu, gunakan 'would have gone'.
hints: 'But for' = 'If it had not been for'.
Gunakan 'would have gone'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi formal Third Conditional.
intermediate.targetSentence: Had we known the risks we would not have invested.
intermediate.explanation: Had we known the risks + we would not have invested.
hints: Inversi: awali dengan 'Had we known the risks'.
Klausa hasil: 'we would not have invested'.

dialogue: Advisor
Do you regret turning down the scholarship?
Student
Deeply. If I had accepted it, I ___ graduating from Harvard this spring.
intermediate.explanation: Kondisi lampau (accepted) yang mempengaruhi status wisuda saat ini (this spring): 'would be graduating'.
hints: Hasil masa kini (this spring).
Gunakan 'would be graduating'.

intermediate.prompt: Mixed Conditional (Past cause → Present result): 'If I had taken that intensive Python course last year, I ___ much more confident at work today.'
intermediate.explanation: Sebab terjadi di masa lalu ('had taken ... last year'), tetapi hasilnya dirasakan SEKARANG ('today'): klausa hasil memakai Tipe 2 'would + V1 (would feel)', BUKAN 'would have felt'.
hints: Perhatikan penanda waktu 'today' di ujung kalimat!
Hasil yang berlaku saat ini memakai 'would + V1'.

intermediate.prompt: Now contrast (Present trait → Past action): 'If Elena weren't so afraid of heights, she ___ joined us on the suspension bridge hike last Sunday.'
intermediate.explanation: Kondisi tetap di masa kini ('weren't so afraid' = Tipe 2) memengaruhi kejadian di masa lalu ('last Sunday' = Tipe 3 'would have joined').
hints: If-clause Tipe 2 ('weren't') tentang sifat permanen, hasil lampau ('last Sunday').
Hasil lampau memakai 'would have + V3'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang keputusan masa lalu yang berdampak hingga sekarang.
dialogue: Colleague
Why are we still paying high cloud storage fees this month?
Lead
If we ___ the old database last quarter, we wouldn't face this bill now.
intermediate.explanation: Sebab di masa lalu ('last quarter') memakai Past Perfect Tipe 3 ('had archived'), sementara dampaknya hari ini memakai 'wouldn't face ... now'.
hints: Penyebabnya terjadi di masa lalu ('last quarter').
If-clause sebab masa lalu memakai 'had + V3'.

intermediate.prompt: Had it not been for the night guard's quick reaction, the archive room ___ caught fire.
intermediate.explanation: Frasa inversi Third Conditional 'Had it not been for...' bermakna 'Andaikan bukan karena [kejadian lampau]', selalu diikuti hasil lampau 'would have + V3'.
hints: Perhatikan V3 'caught' di akhir kalimat.
Lengkapi hasil Tipe 3 dengan 'would have'.

intermediate.prompt: If our regional manager spoke Mandarin, he ___ conducted Tuesday's briefing without an interpreter.
intermediate.explanation: Sifat/kemampuan saat ini yang tidak dimiliki ('spoke' = Tipe 2) menghasilkan akibat tidak terjadi pada acara Selasa lalu ('Tuesday's briefing' = Tipe 3 'could have conducted').
hints: Kemampuan bahasa bersifat umum/sekarang, sementara rapatnya Selasa lalu.
Gabungkan if-clause Tipe 2 dengan hasil Tipe 3 ('could have conducted').

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum menyamakan kedua sisi Mixed Conditional berikut.
intermediate.draft: If we hadn't missed the morning shuttle, we wouldn't have been sitting in this noisy terminal right now.
options: If we hadn't missed the morning shuttle, we wouldn't be sitting in this noisy terminal right now.
If we didn't miss the morning shuttle, we wouldn't have been sitting in this noisy terminal right now.
If we wouldn't have missed the morning shuttle, we wouldn't be sitting in this noisy terminal right now.
intermediate.explanation: Kata 'right now' menunjukkan hasil yang sedang terjadi saat ini (Continuous Tipe 2: 'wouldn't be sitting'), sedangkan sebabnya sudah terjadi pagi tadi ('hadn't missed').
hints: Cek kata penanda waktu 'right now' di akhir kalimat.
Hasil sekarang memakai 'wouldn't be sitting'.

intermediate.prompt: ___ we received the customs clearance on Friday, the spare turbines would already be operating.
intermediate.explanation: Inversi if-clause Tipe 3 menghapus 'If' dan menukar 'Had' ke depan subjek ('Had we received...').
hints: Tidak ada kata 'If' di awal kalimat.
Inversi Tipe 3 memakai 'Had + Subject + V3'.

intermediate.prompt: Without your generous seed grant two years ago, this rural clinic ___ even exist today.
intermediate.explanation: 'Without + noun phrase (two years ago)' bertindak sebagai sebab masa lalu, dan hasil masa kini ('exist today') memakai Tipe 2 'wouldn't + V1 (wouldn't exist)'.
hints: Perhatikan V1 'exist' dan waktu 'today'.
Hasil saat ini memakai 'wouldn't'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Mixed Conditional (sebab masa lalu → akibat saat ini).
intermediate.targetSentence: If she had accepted that promotion in 2020, she would live in Zurich now.
intermediate.explanation: 'Had accepted' (Tipe 3 masa lalu) menghasilkan situasi sekarang 'would live ... now' (Tipe 2).
hints: Awali dengan 'If she had accepted that promotion in 2020,'.
Akhiri dengan 'she would live in Zurich now'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi Third Conditional tanpa kata 'If'.
intermediate.targetSentence: Had the committee verified those figures sooner, the error would have surfaced early.
intermediate.explanation: 'Had + S + V3' menggantikan 'If the committee had verified...'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Had the committee verified those figures sooner,'.
Lanjutkan klausa hasil 'the error would have surfaced early'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan umum penempatan 'would have' di dalam klausa IF.
complex.draft: If the government would have implemented the tax reform earlier, the deficit would not have escalated.
options: If the government had implemented the tax reform earlier, the deficit would not have escalated.
If the government implemented the tax reform earlier, the deficit would not have escalated.
Had the government would implement the tax reform earlier, the deficit would not have escalated.
complex.explanation: Dalam standar bahasa Inggris akademik baku, modal 'would have' tidak boleh berada di dalam anak kalimat IF. Wajib menggunakan Past Perfect ('had implemented').
hints: Hilangkan 'would have' dari anak kalimat IF.
Gunakan Past Perfect: 'had implemented'.

complex.prompt: Evaluate formal structure: '___ it not been for the whistleblower's testimony, the fraud might never have been uncovered.'
complex.explanation: Idiom formal inversi pengandaian lampau: 'Had it not been for + noun' (seandainya bukan karena...).
hints: Idiom inversi masa lampau.
Gunakan 'Had it not been for'.

complex.prompt: Subtle nuances: 'If he were smarter, he wouldn't have made that error.' What type of mixed conditional is this?
options: Present general trait (were) affecting a past specific action (wouldn't have made).
complex.explanation: Klausa IF memakai Past Subjunctive ('were') untuk sifat umum yang berlaku saat ini, menghasilkan akibat kesalahan spesifik di masa lalu ('wouldn't have made').
hints: Sifat kecerdasan umum masa kini mempengaruhi blunder masa lalu.
Pilih present trait affecting past action.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat pengandaian formal inversi 'Had it not been for'.
complex.targetSentence: Had it not been for your guidance we would have failed.
complex.explanation: Had it not been for your guidance + we would have failed.
hints: Mulai dengan inversi: 'Had it not been for your guidance'.
Klausa hasil: 'we would have failed'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi inkonsistensi waktu pada mixed conditional.
complex.draft: If you had remembered to charge the laptop last night, you will not be searching for an outlet now.
options: If you had remembered to charge the laptop last night, you would not be searching for an outlet now.
If you remembered to charge the laptop last night, you will not be searching for an outlet now.
If you had remembered to charge the laptop last night, you had not searched for an outlet now.
complex.explanation: Hasil masa kini ('now') dari pengandaian lampau wajib menggunakan conditional modal 'would not be searching', bukan future 'will not'.
hints: 'Now' menandai akibat masa kini.
Gunakan 'would not be searching'.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence with accurate register and inverted conditional form:
options: Had the negotiations broken down, severe trade sanctions would immediately have been imposed.
If had the negotiations broken down, severe sanctions would have imposed.
Should the negotiations had broken down, severe sanctions would be imposed.
complex.explanation: Pola inversi 'Had + Subject + V3, would have + V3' sangat lazim dan berterima dalam konteks hukum, politik, dan diplomasi formal.
hints: Struktur inversi murni tanpa kata if.
Pilih opsi pertama.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog diplomasi dengan inversi bersyarat.
dialogue: Ambassador
Was the ceasefire treaty close to collapsing?
Envoy
Extremely. ___ the mediator stepped in, war would have erupted within hours.
complex.explanation: Bentuk inversi lampau negatif: 'Had not the mediator stepped in...' (atau Had the mediator not stepped in...).
hints: Inversi lampau dengan auxiliary Had.
Gunakan 'Had not'.

complex.prompt: Look closely at this complex counterfactual: 'But for our mentor's intervention last month, the negotiation ___ collapsed completely.'
complex.explanation: 'But for + noun phrase' bermakna 'Andaikan bukan karena [intervensi bulan lalu]', sehingga klausa hasil masa lampaunya memakai Third Conditional ('would have collapsed').
hints: Ada kata 'last month' dan V3 'collapsed'.
Hasil pengandaian masa lampau memakai 'would have'.

complex.prompt: Compare: 'If you ___ listened to my warning, you wouldn't be dealing with this audit crisis now — AND if you weren't so stubborn, you ___ ignored the email yesterday.'
complex.explanation: Klausa pertama adalah Past→Present ('had listened ... wouldn't be dealing now'); klausa kedua adalah Present→Past ('weren't so stubborn ... wouldn't have ignored yesterday').
hints: Periksa pola masing-masing klausa secara terpisah.
Klausa 1 butuh 'had'; klausa 2 butuh hasil lampau 'wouldn't have'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan inversi negatif Third Conditional ('Hadn't...') berikut.
complex.draft: Hadn't the harbor pilots spotted the drifting barge, it would have struck the pier.
options: Had the harbor pilots not spotted the drifting barge, it would have struck the pier.
Hadn't if the harbor pilots spotted the drifting barge, it would have struck the pier.
Did the harbor pilots not spotted the drifting barge, it would have struck the pier.
complex.explanation: ATURAN KETAT INVERSI: Dalam inversi formal ('Had + Subject + not + V3'), bentuk singkatan negatif 'Hadn't' TIDAK PERNAH boleh diletakkan di awal kalimat sebelum subjek! Selalu pisahkan 'not' setelah subjek: 'Had the harbor pilots not spotted...'.
hints: Dalam inversi kondisional negatif, dilarang memakai singkatan 'Hadn't' di posisi depan.
Pindahkan 'not' ke posisi sesudah subjek: 'Had + S + not + V3'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang variasi 'might have been' dalam Mixed Conditional.
dialogue: Advisor
Why didn't the field team finish mapping the glacier in June?
Student
If their budget weren't so limited this year, they ___ able to charter two helicopters back in June.
complex.explanation: Keterbatasan dana saat ini ('weren't so limited' = Tipe 2) menjelaskan ketidakmampuan di bulan Juni lalu ('might have been able to... back in June' = hasil modal Tipe 3).
hints: Hasilnya terjadi di bulan Juni lalu ('back in June').
Gunakan 'might have been'.

complex.prompt: Suppose the treaty ___ ratified in 1995 instead of failing by two votes; coastal fisheries ___ far healthier today.
complex.explanation: 'Suppose' menggantikan 'If'; kejadian tahun 1995 yang tidak terjadi memakai Pasif Past Perfect ('had been ratified'), dan kondisi perikanan hari ini memakai Tipe 2 ('would be').
hints: Klausa 1 merujuk tahun 1995 (pasif Tipe 3); klausa 2 merujuk kondisi hari ini (Tipe 2).
Pilih 'had been / would be'.

complex.prompt: Even if the backup cooling pump ___ activated automatically, the core would still have overheated without external grid power.
complex.explanation: Dalam Third Conditional pasif ('would still have overheated'), if-clause 'Even if...' memerlukan Past Perfect Passive: 'had been + V3 (activated)'.
hints: Klausa hasil memakai 'would still have overheated'.
Pasif Past Perfect memakai 'had been activated'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan pengandaian ganda dengan 'otherwise' dan 'would' pada kalimat argumen formal berikut.
complex.draft: Our engineers fortified the sea wall last winter; otherwise, the spring tide will flood the entire substation.
options: Our engineers fortified the sea wall last winter; otherwise, the spring tide would have flooded the entire substation.
Our engineers fortified the sea wall last winter; otherwise, the spring tide flooded the entire substation.
Our engineers had fortified the sea wall last winter; otherwise, the spring tide would flood the entire substation tomorrow.
complex.explanation: Ketika 'otherwise' (= jika tidak begitu) memproyeksikan akibat pengandaian di masa lalu ('last winter / spring tide' yang sudah berlalu), klausa sesudah 'otherwise' memakai hasil Third Conditional ('would have flooded').
hints: Akibat pengandaiannya bersifat lampau kontrafaktual.
Setelah 'otherwise' pada konteks lampau, pakai 'would have + V3'.

complex.prompt: Had I not ___ that tiny footnote in Appendix C, we would still be applying the obsolete tax rate today.
complex.explanation: Inversi negatif Tipe 3 ('Had + S + not + V3') membutuhkan Past Participle 'spotted', berpasangan dengan hasil berkelanjutan masa kini ('would still be applying ... today').
hints: Setelah 'Had I not', verb harus berbentuk V3 ('spotted').
Ini contoh inversi Mixed Conditional.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi negatif Third Conditional (tanpa singkatan 'Hadn't').
complex.targetSentence: Had the crew not double-checked the fuel gauge, the vessel would have stalled offshore.
complex.explanation: Inversi negatif formal wajib memisahkan 'not' setelah subjek: 'Had the crew not double-checked...'.
hints: Awali dengan 'Had the crew not double-checked'.
Lengkapi klausa hasil 'the vessel would have stalled offshore'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat pengandaian campuran (sifat permanen sekarang → aksi lampau).
complex.targetSentence: If Maya didn't speak Korean fluently, she couldn't have led yesterday's Seoul briefing.
complex.explanation: 'Didn't speak' (kondisi umum sekarang, Tipe 2) memengaruhi kemampuan pada 'yesterday's Seoul briefing' ('couldn't have led', Tipe 3).
hints: Mulai dengan 'If Maya didn't speak Korean fluently,'.
Akhiri dengan 'she couldn't have led yesterday's Seoul briefing'.
